summary: Kept usage folds are bounded by their weight in incarnations and rollup series rather than by agent count, and a single fold too heavy to keep is folded afresh on each read

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: Usage summaries are unchanged; only which in-memory folds are kept differs.

recovery.detail: In-memory only; a restart or rollback folds afresh without changing durable state.
